hook.status: Complete outer dimensions from official head/neck S-hook listing; open C-bend centreline is an approximation, not manufacturer CAD. Same available reference hardware is tested in all three prototypes, not a scale standard.
hook.pose: Open lower U/C bend is rope-bearing and rests across neck-hole shoulders; upper open bend and stem remain above seat in cavity.

cord_status: Two 2.2 mm strands with a loop over the lower bend. Rigid envelope rotates with the reference hook for a conservative geometric assembly study; actual elastic flexibility not simulated.

inherited_source_parameters.body_neck_circumference_status: Design reference only, not a measurement or a socket diameter conversion.
inherited_source_parameters.policy: Only local internal hardware changes. Remove central locator and its pad, retain exterior shape and all facial detail. Fit catalog magnets with provisional adhesive clearance.
inherited_source_parameters.parameter_limits: Active hardware fields control pocket diameter/depth and local locator removal. Existing body/size/eye fields record unchanged source design; no whole-head resizing or face edit in this builder.
inherited_source_parameters.physical_fit: NOT TESTED: pocket clearances provisional; no print or adhesive/magnet trial.

policy: Reference S-hook plus attached cord must enter from below the neck, lift, turn 90 degrees and settle across the opening. Enlarge the neck passage through both original platform and added spherical cap; retain exterior head/face and cap/magnets. Original lower slot and some socket surface necessarily change locally.
physical_fit: NOT TESTED physically. Full reference-hook pass/turn/seat path must be checked on final mesh; reference curve is approximate. No universal hook/body compatibility or load rating.
groove_surface_profile: Three shallow transverse troughs: full X depth weight within +/-6 mm, quintic fade to zero by +/-7.5 mm; total 15 mm remains inside 18 mm reference hook span. Actual shoulders/contact and turn resistance must be verified.
